hero.title: From data chaos to confident decisions
hero.subtitle: Wabi Insight lets your teams ask natural-language questions about the enterprise data they are authorized to see, and returns verified answers, charts and reports they can trust and share.

ask.title: Ask in plain language
ask.text: Employees ask questions in English or Arabic and receive verified results, not guesses.

trust.title: Trust every answer
trust.text: Typed query plans, read-only execution and deterministic calculations keep numbers accurate.

secure.title: Secure by design
secure.text: Organization isolation, table, column and row permissions, encrypted connections, full audit.

share.title: Report and share
share.text: Dashboards, PDF, Word and Excel reports in both languages, shared under control.

step1.title: Connect
step1.text: Your administrator registers SQL Server or Oracle applications and approves the metadata users may see.

step2.title: Ask
step2.text: Users ask questions. The AI drafts a structured plan that Wabi Insight validates and authorizes before running read-only SQL.

step3.title: Decide
step3.text: Verified results become tables, charts, narratives and reports, saved to history and shared with the right people.

security.title: Built for multi-organization trust
security.text: Each organization keeps its own users, roles, data sources and history. The platform company operates the service without access to customer business data, and support work needs an approved, time-limited, audited grant.

points.isolation: Logical tenant isolation enforced in the database and the API
points.permissions: Table, column and row-level permissions applied before every query
points.audit: Append-only audit trail and support-access approval workflow

cta.title: Ready to ask your data?
cta.text: Sign in with the account your organization administrator provided.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your organization or platform account.
login.noAccount: No public registration. Accounts are created by your organization administrator.

errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.locked_out: The account is temporarily locked after repeated failed attempts. Try again later.
errors.account_disabled: This account is not active. Contact your administrator.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.antiforgery: Your session token expired. Please try again.

changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.required: You must change your password before continuing.
changePassword.policy: Use 12 to 128 characters. Longer passphrases are better than complex short ones.

errors.password_too_short: The new password is too short (minimum 12 characters).
errors.password_too_long: The new password is too long (maximum 128 characters).
errors.password_equals_email: The password must not be your email address.
errors.password_is_sample: The sample development password is not allowed.
errors.password_unchanged: Choose a password different from the current one.

bootstrap.title: Platform bootstrap
bootstrap.subtitle: One-time creation of the first Platform Administrator.
bootstrap.disabled: Bootstrap is disabled in this deployment. Enable it in the deployment configuration or use the CLI command.
bootstrap.secretHint: The Bootstrap:InitializationSecret value from the deployment configuration.
bootstrap.success: The first Platform Administrator was created. Sign in and change the password.

ask.title: Ask Wabi Insight
ask.subtitle: Ask a question about your authorized data in English or Arabic.
ask.noApplications: No applications are configured yet. Your organization administrator registers them in Phase 6; the built-in Platform Insights application arrives in Phase 7.
ask.promptPlaceholder: For example: Which departments used Wabi Insight most this month?

examples.e1: How many active users are registered in my organization?
examples.e2: Show a monthly chart of AI usage by department.
examples.e3: How many reports were shared internally last quarter?

ask.engineComing: The secure AI engine (query plans, authorization and SQL compilation) is delivered in Phase 8. Your question was not sent anywhere.
